cases.coverage: omitting both anchors copies the complete transcript
beforeMessageId copies only entries before the selected message
before-message aliases use first-present semantics and a present null camel alias suppresses the snake alias
throughTurnId copies one verified terminal turn inclusively
every present through-turn alias must be a matching non-empty string
a truthy before-message anchor and through-turn anchor are mutually exclusive
an omitted or empty title retains numbered fork-title generation
through-turn success includes forkMode and the normalized throughTurnId
